impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Support for EU biodiversity and climate objectives through policy-relevant ecosystem assessment, protection, restoration planning and biodiversity trend prediction.
impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The project feeds policy-relevant assessment from observation through to prediction. WP4 delivers comparable datasets across the terrestrial, freshwater and marine realms (D4.1 to D4.4). WP6 scales habitat classification to European coverage and publishes trend predictions with stated uncertainty (D6.2, D6.3). WP7 shapes these outputs to the reporting obligations competent authorities carry (D7.1 to D7.4) and plans their coordination and uptake (D1.2). The valuation clause of the destination's fourth impact is only partly addressed. No partner carries environmental economics, so the project improves the evidence a valuation rests on and runs no valuation itself.
impact_pathways.coverage_note: Deliverables resolved from the explicit linked_deliverable_ids of outcomes OC3, OC6 and OC7 (outcomes.json), reached from project impacts IMP1 and IMP4 (impacts.json). The valuation-clause limitation is carried as Unresolved in impacts.json destination_expected_impacts.partly_addressed_clauses.

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Progress toward the goals of the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 and the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, including assessment of progress against their defined targets.
impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The project reports against the international biodiversity frameworks rather than beside them. WP3 builds crosswalks so every published habitat label resolves to the European classification and a global ecosystem typology (D3.2). WP3 then takes the harmonisation decisions to the bodies that maintain those classifications and publishes occurrence records to the global data facilities the topic names (D3.4, built on D1.1, D3.1 and D3.3). This makes the project's evidence countable in an assessment of progress toward the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 and the Kunming-Montreal framework.
impact_pathways.coverage_note: Deliverables resolved from the explicit linked_deliverable_ids of outcome OC2 (outcomes.json), reached from project impact IMP6, which addresses the destination's international-commitments impact (DEST-IMPACT-6).

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Biodiversity preservation becomes a mainstream feature of other sectors, such as agriculture, transport, energy and the bioeconomy, enabled by FAIR data on species and ecosystems.
impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The project moves biodiversity evidence into the sector that creates the pressure. WP7 delivers biodiversity indicators inside existing farm-management tools and asks practitioners whether they can act on them (D7.2, D7.3), then transfers the measurement protocol to a second production context (D1.2, D7.1, D7.4). FAIR release underpins this reuse. WP3 publishes the protocols, crosswalks and pipeline to the open science cloud and the common data spaces (D1.1, D3.1 to D3.4), and WP6 publishes the classification models and maps (D6.2, D6.3). Uptake through the farm-management network depends on partner P05, whose participation is Assumed.
impact_pathways.coverage_note: Deliverables resolved from the explicit linked_deliverable_ids of outcomes OC7, OC2 and OC6 (outcomes.json), reached from project impacts IMP5 and IMP2. The uptake-channel dependency on P05 is recorded as a limit in impacts.json IMP5.

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Improved knowledge on the status and trends of habitats, species and ecosystems, and on the drivers of decline, built on systemic, harmonised or standardised biodiversity data.
impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The project improves knowledge of status, trends and drivers on harmonised data. Three campaigns run under one protocol along a single agricultural pressure gradient (D4.1 to D4.4), so the same load is measured in three realms. The omics layer names the molecular signal of that load and binds it to in-situ and satellite records (D5.1 to D5.3). WP6 turns the harmonised observations into European-scale maps and benchmarked classification (D6.2, D6.3). The cross-case verification report states which harmonisation decisions survived transfer between realms (D4.4).
impact_pathways.coverage_note: Deliverables resolved from the explicit linked_deliverable_ids of outcomes OC3, OC6 and OC4 (outcomes.json), reached from project impacts IMP1 and IMP3.

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Enhanced AI, machine learning and statistical applications for habitat classification, ecosystem mapping and biodiversity trend prediction, drawing on improved in-situ training and validation datasets.
impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The project supplies the training and validation data that AI habitat classification needs. WP6 reworks field archives into a documented training and validation resource with a declared, leakage-safe split protocol (D6.1). It trains and benchmarks habitat and ecosystem classification models on the harmonised observations (D6.2) and predicts biodiversity trends at European coverage with stated uncertainty (D6.3). The joint protocols and crosswalks make the training data interoperable and reusable (D1.1, D3.1 to D3.4), resting on the observations WP4 produces (D4.1 to D4.4).
impact_pathways.coverage_note: EI-05 is the inferred technological impact derived from expected outcome EO-03 (expected_impacts.json inference_note). Outcome OC5 carries the explicit tier2b_expected_outcome_ref to expected_outcomes[2] (EO-03) and links deliverable D6.1, so D6.1 enters this pathway through documented Tier 2B-to-Tier 3 linkage, not heuristic title matching. Remaining deliverables resolved from the explicit linked_deliverable_ids of outcomes OC6, OC2 and OC3, reached from project impacts IMP2 and IMP1.

kpis.description: Biodiversity knowledge gaps prioritised, each with the data need behind it named.
kpis.target: Every priority gap identified in the demonstration realms carries a named data need. A count is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed; impacts.json kpis_note).
kpis.measurement_method: Count of prioritised gaps recorded in D2.1, each cross-referenced to a stated data need.

kpis.description: Harmonisation decisions tested in a realm that did not design them, and the share that survived.
kpis.target: The share surviving transfer is reported per decision. No threshold is committed until the consortium is confirmed (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Cross-case verification in D4.4: count of harmonisation decisions re-tested in a non-originating realm and the survival share.

kpis.description: Molecular records joinable to an in-situ and a satellite record of the same place through the published metadata.
kpis.target: Molecular records for the demonstration cases are queryable jointly with in-situ and satellite records. A join rate is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Genome-to-space linkage report D5.3: share of molecular records resolvable to a co-located in-situ and satellite observation through the published metadata standard.

kpis.description: Observation datasets delivered under one protocol, one per ecosystem realm.
kpis.target: Three datasets, one each for the terrestrial, freshwater and marine realm (D4.1, D4.2, D4.3). The count is structural to the WP4 design; delivery is contingent on confirmation of the realm-lead partners (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Count of realm observation datasets delivered under the joint protocol, verified against the WP4 deliverable set.

kpis.description: European-scale maps and trend predictions published with stated uncertainty.
kpis.target: All published maps and trend predictions carry an explicit uncertainty statement. Coverage extent is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Review of D6.3: share of published European-scale maps and trend predictions that report uncertainty derived from the case benchmarks.

kpis.description: Reporting obligations for which an output is accepted by a competent authority without rework.
kpis.target: Each reporting obligation assessed in D7.1 has an output shaped to it before design. The accepted-without-rework count is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Policy reporting needs assessment D7.1: count of reporting obligations whose mapped output a competent authority accepts without rework.

kpis.description: Share of the project's habitat labels that resolve to both the European classification and the global typology.
kpis.target: Every published habitat label resolves to both the European classification and the global ecosystem typology. A share is confirmed on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Interoperability crosswalk package D3.2: share of habitat labels with a resolvable crosswalk to both target classifications.

kpis.description: Harmonisation decisions submitted to the bodies that maintain the classifications, and their disposition.
kpis.target: Each project harmonisation decision is submitted to the relevant standards body and its disposition recorded. A submission count is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: FAIR publication and standards contribution report D3.4: count of decisions submitted to standards bodies with recorded disposition.

kpis.description: Agricultural holdings in the user network that evaluate the indicators, and the share reporting they could act on them.
kpis.target: Holdings in the user network evaluate the indicators and report actionability. Counts depend on partner P05's participation and are set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Farm-management integration and usability evaluation D7.3: count of holdings evaluating indicators and share reporting they could act on them.

kpis.description: Datasets and services registered in the open science cloud and the common data spaces.
kpis.target: Project datasets and services are registered in the open science cloud and common data spaces. A registration count is set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: FAIR publication and standards contribution report D3.4: count of datasets and services registered in the named infrastructures.

kpis.description: Training and validation sets published with a declared split protocol and a reproducible benchmark.
kpis.target: The training and validation resource is published with a declared, leakage-safe split protocol and a reproducible benchmark. Set count is confirmed on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Review of D6.1: presence of a declared split protocol and a benchmark an external group can reproduce.

kpis.description: Classification benchmark scores reported per case under the declared split, with uncertainty.
kpis.target: Benchmark scores are reported for each demonstration case under the declared split, with uncertainty. Score targets are set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).
kpis.measurement_method: Habitat and ecosystem classification models D6.2: per-case benchmark scores reported under the D6.1 split protocol, with uncertainty.

activities.timing: After the reporting-needs assessment D7.1, then as outputs mature

dissemination_plan.open_access_policy: The project releases its protocols, crosswalks, provenance-tracked pipeline and classification models under FAIR terms to the European Open Science Cloud and the common data spaces (D1.1, D3.1 to D3.4, D6.1, D6.2). A data management plan is delivered within the first six months and updated periodically. Occurrence records are published to the global data facilities the topic names (D3.4). A group outside the consortium can apply the released methods without asking the consortium (IMP2).

activities.activity_type: Embedding biodiversity indicators in existing farm-management tools
activities.expected_result: Agricultural holdings in the user network evaluate the indicators and report whether they can act on them (D7.2, D7.3)
activities.timing: Once observation-derived indicators exist, in the later project years

activities.activity_type: Transfer of the measurement protocol to a second production context
activities.expected_result: A second production context runs the same measurement under the transferred protocol (D1.2, D7.1, D7.4)
activities.responsible_partner: WP7 lead, with P05 (partners Assumed; consortium unconfirmed)
activities.timing: After the first protocol is validated in the demonstration cases

activities.activity_type: Release of the training and validation resource and classification models for reuse
activities.expected_result: External groups reproduce the benchmark under the declared split and apply the models without consortium support (D6.1, D6.2)
activities.timing: On publication of the training resource and benchmarked models

exploitation_plan.ipr_strategy: Results are released openly under FAIR terms, consistent with the topic's requirement for FAIR data on species and ecosystems (EI-03). Datasets, protocols, crosswalks and classification models carry a public dissemination level so reuse needs no consortium permission (IMP2). Tier 3 records no explicit IPR data and no commercial valuation, because no partner carries environmental economics; protection measures beyond open licensing are set on consortium confirmation (Assumed).

sustainability_mechanism.description: Results persist through the infrastructures that already outlast the project. The FAIR datasets, protocols, crosswalks and models registered in the European Open Science Cloud and the common data spaces remain available and reusable after the project ends (IMP2, K08). Harmonisation decisions accepted by the standards bodies persist through those bodies' maintained classifications (IMP6, K09). Reporting-shaped outputs continue to serve the recurring obligations competent authorities carry (IMP4). The measurement protocol transferred to a second production context continues to run there through the user network (IMP5). The farm-management uptake route depends on partner P05, whose participation is Assumed.

activities.target_audience: Growers in the user network as practitioners, and the regional and sector agricultural press
activities.objective: Show that biodiversity indicators are usable inside the farm-management tools growers already run
activities.timing: In the later project years, once indicators are embedded in the tools

activities.target_audience: The interested public and civil society beyond the research and user communities
activities.objective: Make society better informed of biodiversity status, trends and the drivers of loss, as the destination requires (DEST-IMPACT-4)
activities.timing: Throughout the project, alongside published results
